points: Joule Studio checks permissions, role policies and process context before an agent action reaches the OpenShell runtime
SAP engineers contribute supervisor/agent-layer separation, Kubernetes operator support and health monitoring to OpenShell
Joule Studio runtime free for SAP customers and partners from October 2026; FedRAMP and FIPS on joint roadmap
take: SAP pairs an isolated open-source agent runtime with its own permission, policy and audit layer, a template for controlling what enterprise agents may execute. Vendor claims.
title: SAP: puts NVIDIA OpenShell sandbox under Joule Studio agent governance
